messages:
Avery: Morning folks — quick leadership check-in. Three asks this week: 1) finalize Dedicated capacity rebalances by Wed EOD, 2) complete private-beta compliance checklist (notably data-retention updates), 3) freeze model-variant rollouts until perf certs are green. Please call out blockers. :chart_with_upwards_trend:

Priya: Ack. Product will prioritize the retention checklist. Sharing evals and prompt sets by Tue AM. Link to latest metrics: https://redwood.app/metrics/weekly (internal)

Diego: Saw a 12% tail-latency spike in Saturday stress tests — kernel selection skewed across nodes. We're pinning the kernel profile to v2 for impacted pools and rolling back the last optimizer change tonight. Postmortem scheduled.

Sam: On Dedicated rebalances — ops has a plan to shift 20% of low-util pools into burstable capacity. Need final list of pools from Eng by Tue noon. Also watch the autoscale cooldown params; they're too aggressive right now.

Maya: Heads-up on cost: if we do the full rebalance plus burst capacity, forecasted monthly infra spend +6% in Q next month. Can we identify 1–2 mitigations (quant profiles, tighter batching) to offset? 

Linh: For on-call rotations — can we keep the current handover pattern? I don't want to change paging midweek. If we need extra coverage for the rollback, I'll swap with Mateo on Wed.

Rishi: I'll run the incident postmortem with Diego. Quick ask: Diego, can you drop the profiler logs and the kernel-selection diff in the incident channel? I'll tag the SRE pager and timeline.

deploy-bot: prod-deploy: rollback/optimizer-change → success (5880023460). No customer-facing error alerts. :white_check_mark:

Avery: Thanks — concrete owners: Diego (perf rollback & postmortem), Priya (retention checklist), Sam (pool list + cooldown), Maya (cost mitigations), Rishi (postmortem coordination), Linh (on-call handover). Let's sync Thu 09:30 PT for a 15m readout. If anything urgent ping me or @sam. :raised_hands:
